name: CMN Synapse
synopsis: The reference CMN indexer — ingests signed manifests, indexes spores and myceliums, serves discovery queries, and syncs across instances via Nostr.
intent: Deliver a federated indexer implementing the Synapse protocol with verifiable ingestion and synchronization: HTTP/HTTPS serving, certificate automation, signed pulse processing, background crawling, relay-based cross-instance sync, and optional vector/graph query acceleration
Enable decentralized spore discovery — anyone can run a Synapse instance, index spores from any domain, and be queried by hypha or any CMN-aware agent
mutations: Replace clap with an agent-first-data closed-world CLI registry — `synapse --help` returns a strict cli-help-v2 event, `--docs` renders the CLI reference published as docs/cli.md, and argv resolves before any configuration, secret, or network I/O; structural CLI errors exit 2 while service startup failures exit 1 as strict protocol-v1 error events carrying a stable code, message, and hint

Load configuration through afdata's DocumentFile with a size cap and extension probing, so a malformed or oversized config reports a coded document error (document_parse_failed / document_too_large) instead of echoing file content, and validation failures stop quoting the offending value back

Redact secrets everywhere a URL can reach an event — HTTP response bodies, diagnostic prose, and the startup config dump all scrub credentials and secret query parameters from CMN's protocol-defined bare `url` fields, legacy embedding `url`, and legacy Nostr `relays` entries, without renaming the fields the spec defines

Rename service tracing fields to Agent-First Data suffix conventions (expires_at → expires_at_rfc3339, addr → listen_addr, bare counts → *_count) and convert the remaining interpolated log messages into structured fields
Support yaml alongside json and plain as the service log format, emitting the nested startup config event through a strict-protocol emitter
Upgrade the stack — agent-first-data 0.31, cmn-substrate 0.4 (nutrient extra-field preservation), base64 0.23, serial_test 4 — and drop the clap and serde_yaml dependencies

bonds.reason: Deployed HTTP service — declares base URLs in service.json and provides GET /health
Implements the Synapse protocol — pulse ingestion, spore retrieval, lineage traversal, mycelium listing
Implements full-text search across indexed spores when search feature is enabled
Implements Nostr relay and pulse forwarding when nostr feature is enabled
All API response fields and log events use Agent-First Data suffix conventions
Implements the CMN protocol specification — reference Synapse indexer
